title: Language Steering for Multilingual In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.02326v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: If multilingual language model representations contain separable language-associated structure, then shifting between languages may require only simple activation-space interventions. To test this hypothesis, we study multilingual in-context learning (ICL) as a controlled setting: few-shot demonstrations are provided in English while the test query is in a target language, creating a clear cross-lingual transfer challenge. We propose language vectors, which are computed as mean activation differences between parallel source and target language examples at a particular layer and applied as inference-time offsets to the model's hidden states. Across three tasks spanning 19 languages and three models, our method improves over English few-shot prompting without any parameter updates. translated_title: 面向多语言上下文学习的语言引导
translated_abstract: 如果多语言语言模型的表示中包含可分离的与语言相关的结构，那么在语言之间切换可能只需要简单的激活空间干预。为了验证这一假设，我们将多语言上下文学习（ICL）作为一个受控的研究场景：少样本示例以英语提供，而测试查询使用目标语言，从而构成一个明确的跨语言迁移挑战。我们提出了“语言向量”（language vectors），其通过在特定层上计算平行源语言与目标语言示例之间的平均激活差异得到，并在推理时作为偏移量应用于模型的隐藏状态。在涵盖19种语言的三项任务和三个模型上，我们的方法无需任何参数更新即可超越英语少样本提示的表现。除性能提升外，这些向量还编码了可解释的语言学结构：亲缘关系相近的语言形成紧密的聚类，并且向量能够有效地跨模……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“语言向量”——通过在特定层计算平行语言示例间的平均激活差异，并在推理时作为偏移量注入模型隐藏状态，无需任何参数更新即可显著提升多语言上下文学习中的跨语言迁移性能，且这些向量呈现出可解释的语言学聚类结构。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "language vectors"—mean activation differences between parallel source and target language examples applied as inference-time offsets to hidden states—which improve multilingual in-context learning across 19 languages and three models without any parameter updates, while encoding interpretable linguistic structure such as clustering of closely related languages.
